Test Case Description: Classification uses Consignee Name keyword then Consignee Number AR Business Type rules
Test Steps:
1. Ensure no B2B keyword matches the test consignee name
2. Process shipment with Consignee Number not available and verify result B2C
3. Process shipment with Consignee Number available and AR Business Type E-Commerce and verify B2C
4. Process shipment with Consignee Number available and AR Business Type Wholesale and verify B2B
5. Process shipment with Consignee Number available and AR Business Type Corporate Business and verify B2B
6. Process shipment with Consignee Number available and AR Business Type Oil and Gas and verify B2B
7. Process shipment with Consignee Number available and AR Business Type Retail (Cash) and verify B2C
Acceptance Criteria: CCIPH-476 B2B vs B2C Classification of Shipments
Expected Result: Shipment B2B/B2C outcome follows the documented order: B2B keyword match first then Consignee Number absence equals B2C then AR Business Type mapping for E-Commerce/Retail Cash to B2C and Wholesale/Corporate Business/Oil and Gas to B2B.
Automation Remarks: Split into separate automated scripts per mapping if preferred; keep seed data matrix
